# windows_iis_site (Data Source)

Reads the observed state of an existing IIS site by `name` on a remote Windows host without managing it. Connection timeout surfaces in whole seconds, converted server-side. The `bindings` view (`protocol` plus `binding_information`) is read-only here and managed by `windows_iis_site_binding`.

Requires IIS on the target host (`windows_feature` `Web-Server`).

Returns an error when the site does not exist on the target host.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    windows = {
      source  = "kfrlabs/windows"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "windows" {
  host     = var.windows_host
  username = var.windows_username
  password = var.windows_password
}

# Read the observed state of the Default Web Site (read-only, no lifecycle).
data "windows_iis_site" "default" {
  name = "Default Web Site"
}

output "default_physical_path" {
  value = data.windows_iis_site.default.physical_path
}

output "default_state" {
  value = data.windows_iis_site.default.state
}

# Inspect a site managed by the windows_iis_site resource in the same
# configuration. The data source returns the observed live state
# (connection timeout in whole seconds; bindings as the read-only view).
data "windows_iis_site" "managed" {
  name = windows_iis_site.web.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Site name on the target host.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `application_pool` (String) Application pool serving the site root, as observed on the host.
- `auto_start` (Boolean) Whether the site starts automatically, as observed on the host.
- `bindings` (Attributes List) Observed site bindings (`protocol` plus `binding_information`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bindings))
- `connection_timeout_seconds` (Number) Connection timeout in whole seconds, as observed on the host.
- `enabled_protocols` (String) Protocols the site root application listens on, as observed on the host.
- `id` (String) Data source identifier: the site name.
- `log_directory` (String) Directory for the site log files, as observed on the host.
- `log_enabled` (Boolean) Whether IIS logging is enabled for the site, as observed on the host.
- `log_format` (String) Log file format, as observed on the host.
- `max_connections` (Number) Maximum concurrent connections, as observed on the host.
- `physical_path` (String) Physical path of the site root, as observed on the host.
- `preload_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the site root application is preloaded, as observed on the host.
- `site_id` (Number) Numeric site ID, as observed on the host.
- `state` (String) Runtime state of the site (`Started` / `Stopped`), as observed on the host.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--bindings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bindings`

Read-Only:

- `binding_information` (String) Binding information (`IP:port:hostheader`).
- `protocol` (String) Binding protocol (e.g. `http`, `https`).
